title: feat: reviewed rewrite loop, score-only reviewer, wasted-cost tracking
body:
## What changed
- \`QuestionReviewer\` only scores: per-criterion \`{score, comment}\` plus a global comment, no corrected question. Fails on any criterion below its floor (correctness 0.9, others 0.7) or an average below 0.85.
- Format invariants (single/multiple-choice answer counts, sorting \`correct_index\` permutation, reviewer \`distractorQuality\` shape) are zod refinements, retried inside \`runAgent\`.
- All 5 builders accept a rewrite (rejected question + reviewer critique).
- \`pipeline.ts\`: per slot, build → review → (on rejection) reviewed rewrite → review; a second rejection or any agent failure fails the slot. Cancellation still propagates.
- \`GenerationMeta.wasted\` (+ migration): calls whose output isn't the final \`Question\` are recorded against the prep as wasted.

## Before merging
- CI migration check passes (migration is handwritten: one \`ALTER TABLE\`).

## After merging
- Deploy applies the migration.
- Failed slots aren't persisted or shown yet, and per-step crash-resume is still per-slot — PR B on #212.

Refs #212
